title: Leo at the party: then vs now
old_caption: Then: a cape, a spotlight, a grand entrance. Now: Leo spots the shy guest and waves them in. Shine, then pass the light.

title: Virgo wrapping gifts: then vs now
old_caption: Measuring ribbon with a ruler at 3 AM, alone. Or crooked bows and friends laughing at the table. Crooked bows, full hearts.

title: Libra’s holiday plans: then vs now
old_caption: "Whatever you want!" three times in a row, or finally saying "I'd love the cabin." Your preference counts too.

title: Scorpio at dinner: then vs now
old_caption: Feelings in a locked vault and "pass the salt," or one honest "I really missed you." One sentence opens the door.

title: Sagittarius's trips: then vs now
old_caption: A note on the door that just says BRB, or a map, a return date and postcards for everyone. Adventures land better with a heads-up.

title: Capricorn on the 24th: then vs now
old_caption: One more email at the holiday table, or the laptop shut and a double six on the board. Out of office means out of office.

title: Aquarius traditions: then vs now
old_caption: Celebrating your made-up holiday alone, or getting everyone into party hats for it. Weird traditions need witnesses.

title: Pisces at the holiday movie: then vs now
old_caption: Crying at the holiday movie alone with one tissue left, or next to a friend holding the box. Cry with company this year.

title: The lights walk: then vs now
old_caption: Four streets of holiday lights in nine minutes, stopwatch out. Or a slow walk that stops at every house. Slow walks count as dates.

title: The drive home: then vs now
old_caption: Two people, one map, "LEFT!" "RIGHT!" Or: you drive, I do snacks. Take turns on the way home this year.
